headline: A college in Illinois tried to cancel its Flock contact and it refused
summary: An Illinois college attempted to cancel its contract with Flock safety cameras. Concerns arose over Flock sharing data with CBP and insecure camera feeds. Flock refused to terminate the contract, leaving the college stuck.

headline: Silicon Valley is falling in line with Trump’s attempt to rename AI
summary: President Trump is pushing to rename Artificial Intelligence to "super intelligence." Some powerful figures in Silicon Valley are beginning to adopt this new term. The broader public, however, is largely sticking with the traditional "AI" designation.

headline: The new Apple TV could have a built-in mic and a remote with a speaker
summary: Rumors suggest the next Apple TV will feature a built-in microphone. Its redesigned remote is expected to include a speaker. These upgrades aim to enhance Siri control and potentially expand the device's smart home capabilities.

headline: NASA dumped over 800GB of Artemis II data online
summary: NASA has released over 800GB of data from the Artemis II mission online. The archive includes more than 11,000 photos, videos, and over 8.5 hours of audio. This massive dump provides new, comprehensive insights into the space mission.

headline: Doom 2016 Composer Mick Gordon Says He'd Return to the Doom Series "In a Heartbeat"
summary: Mick Gordon, composer for Doom 2016, expressed keen interest in returning to the series. He stated he would come back to the Doom franchise "in a heartbeat." This signals potential future collaborations for fans of his iconic work.

headline: Artemis Fowl Animated TV Show Greenlit With Eoin Colfer as Executive Producer
summary: An animated TV series based on Artemis Fowl has been greenlit. The show will air on Disney Channel and Disney+. Original author Eoin Colfer is set to serve as an executive producer.

headline: Resident Evil Overtakes Weapons as Zach Cregger's Highest-Grossing Film, The Social Reckoning Bombs
summary: "Resident Evil" has surpassed "Weapons" to become Zach Cregger's top-grossing film. This success marks a significant milestone for the horror franchise. Meanwhile, Cregger's other film, "The Social Reckoning," performed poorly at the box office.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Doom: The Dark Ages, Star Wars Zero Company, 007 4K Blu-ray, and More
summary: Today's best deals include discounts on "Doom: The Dark Ages." "Star Wars Zero Company" is also featured among the offers. Shoppers can find deals on 007 4K Blu-ray sets and other items.

headline: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
summary: Trump proposed an "energy ceasefire," which Ukrainian President Zelensky welcomed. Kyiv stated it would support such a truce in the ongoing conflict. Russia has remained silent on the proposed ceasefire.

headline: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
summary: A Houthi strike at Riyadh airport killed one person and injured eleven. This marks the second attack on the Saudi capital in two days by the Iran-backed group. Multiple attacks have targeted Riyadh over the weekend, escalating tensions.

headline: PM says it is 'clear' Russia interfered with Brexit vote
summary: The Prime Minister declared it "clear" that Russia interfered with the Brexit vote. He stated that voters were not adequately informed about foreign interference attempts. This raises significant concerns about the integrity of UK democracy.

headline: Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack
summary: Yorkshire Wildlife Park remains closed following a fatal tiger attack. A man entered the tiger enclosure on Saturday and was killed. Authorities are investigating the tragic incident at the park.
